problem.title: Automation: how to automate transforming .doc to .docx?
problem.description: I have a bunch of .doc files in a folder which I need to convert to .docx. To manually convert the .doc to .docx is pretty simple: Open .doc in Word 2007 Click on Save As... Save it as .docx However, doing this for hundreds of files definitely ain't fun. =p How would you automate this?
